prerequisitesFixed: BSC's InayaTokenBridgeHome had no setSpokeBridgeAddress() entry for Solana Devnet (chainId 1000000002) -- registered (tx 0x364762421d3cb604785799caaa9f7508461160dd925f55862324d8085b1f32b8), program ID's raw 32 bytes as the spoke address.
BSC's InayaChainRegistry had never registered Solana Devnet as an active/trusted remote chain -- registered via registerRemoteChain() + setTrustedRemoteContract().
realDryRun.realBugFixed: Solana's native secp256k1 precompile keccak256-hashes the instruction's 'message' field internally before recovering the ECDSA signature -- confirmed empirically (undocumented in the public client-crate docs; multiple official doc pages were checked and gave inconsistent/incomplete answers). receive_message.rs's own parse_secp256k1_instruction compares the raw, UNHASHED message_hash() output against the message field, so the field itself stays unhashed -- the fix is that validators must sign keccak256(message_hash) (one extra hash) instead of message_hash directly. scripts/interop and receive_message.rs's own doc comment (calling this 'HIGHEST-TECHNICAL-RISK CODE... has NOT been exercised against a real instruction') were correct to flag this as unverified -- it needed exactly this real end-to-end attempt to surface and fix.
realDryRun.notes: This is the first-ever proven cross-chain message execution on Inaya's Solana program -- previously wired (admin/home-addresses/validator-set/trusted-chain all confirmed set) but never actually exercised end-to-end.
